---
name: Reproduction report
about: Report a reproduced experiment or mismatch with a baseline
title: "[Reproduction] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Baseline and source

Baseline Bxx, source Lxx/version/hash, and requested output.

## Exact scenario

Matrices/model, initial state, time grid, coordinates/units, objective,
constraints, control domain, uncertainty dependence, and policy class.

## Environment

Implementation/solver versions, settings/tolerances, CPU/GPU, threads, seed.

## Expected and observed results

Keep published and computed numbers separate. Include feasibility,
residuals, bounds/inclusion evidence, runtime and memory if measured.

## Artifacts and interpretation

Attach a minimal reproducible input or link to permitted artifacts.
Explain rounding, approximations and remaining uncertainties.
